column1: # Runs carrying the clock the run was given, added after reference_ms varied in
# a way host load did not explain. mean_mhz and peak_mhz are the mean across
# cores and the highest any core reached, sampled every tenth of a second for
# the interval the compute clients are sampled; samples is how many that was.
# The clock is the same at load 4 as at load 15, which refutes the hypothesis
# that a sustained load holds a package clock an idle machine lets fall.
